scope: Post-FX note-boundary bridge and underrun/recovery ramps only. Core DSP, FX, presets, mono/Legato semantics, Q23 reverb and +6.02 dB remain unchanged.

initialNativeAudit.method: Compare first post-note sample to a no-event counterfactual copied from the pre-event engine with separate FX buffers. Adjacent-sample maxima also include intentional noise and harmonics, not only glitches.
initialNativeAudit.replay: Save source to build/rapid-047rc6/note_probe.c; compile against fixed modules with -DIFW_NOTE_TRANSITIONS=0 to replay rc5 output.

limits: No physical device or analog recording was available; the exact cause of the reported rare hardware pops remains unconfirmed.
Short output bridges can soften retrigger attacks for 64 samples. Core envelope and mono/Legato state are byte-identical to the unmodified engine.
Underrun ramps reduce boundary steps, cannot reconstruct missing audio, and do not hide UND/XRUN counters. Sustained overload remains audible.
Instruction timing is an uncalibrated model; forced 120 MHz is fault injection, not normal hardware performance.
The 938/469-LSB figures measure controlled constant-signal transitions, not a noise floor or universal music click reduction.
